title: Draft rules for the admin-portal design review prototype
draft_notice: UNAPPROVED DRAFT. Compiled by Mihret Netsereab from the cited platform files only. No rule here is an official design-system or accessibility requirement until Mohammed Abdul Aleem approves it.
supplied_by: Mihret Netsereab (draft, compiled from cited platform sources)

standard.note: The platform skill names WCAG 2.1 AA; the BRD draft names WCAG 2.2 AA. Aleem decides.

token_file_sources.quote: This is the source of truth.

rules.title: No hex values in inline styles

sources.quote: never inline styles with hex values

rules.title: No hard-coded hex colour values
rules.scope_note: frontend/CLAUDE.md:35 sits in the src/styles/ row of a folder table, so whether it covers .tsx files is unclear. baseline-ui:42 is the primary source.

rules.title: Form controls have a label or aria-label
Clickable actions use <button>, not <span> or <div> with onClick

sources.quote: Icons used as buttons: `aria-label` on the button

rules.title: Alert messages use role="alert" or aria-live
Loading spinners sit in a live region
No skipped heading levels; one <h1> per page

not_checked.title: Colour contrast
not_checked.reason: Needs the rendered page: colours computed from tokens are not proof of what is visible. The ratio thresholds are also standard-dependent, and the standard is pending confirmation.

not_checked.title: Touch-target size
not_checked.reason: Pending confirmation of the standard, and needs the rendered page. The source itself conflicts: it cites 2.5.8, a WCAG 2.2 criterion, but states 44x44px.

not_checked.title: Keyboard navigation and visible focus
not_checked.reason: Needs a running page to tab through. Not checkable from files.

sources.quote: All interactive elements reachable via Tab

not_checked.title: Reduced motion and high-contrast mode
not_checked.reason: Set in shared stylesheets and checked at runtime. This page imports no stylesheet, and the prototype reviews one file.

sources.quote: no CSS animations bypass this media query
custom styled components respect high contrast mode

not_checked.title: Skip navigation and landmarks
not_checked.reason: Belong to the app shell, not to one page component.

not_checked.title: Error messages linked with aria-describedby, tables, tabs and other ARIA patterns
Inline styles that contain no hex value
not_checked.reason: No cited source forbids them, so they are not reported.

not_checked.title: Layout, information hierarchy and brand voice
not_checked.reason: No approved rules exist for these judgment calls, and no model is used in this prototype.

open_decisions: Target product: InboxAuditLogPage.tsx is a temporary technical demo target, not the target-product decision (portal, design-system repository, or both).
Rules pack approval: every rule above is an unapproved draft.
Accessibility standard: WCAG 2.1 AA or WCAG 2.2 AA.
Colour exceptions: whether raw colours such as third-party brand colours are allowed (R0 decision D5).
Token authority: which token layer is authoritative (R0 definition, section 1.4) and whether near matches count (D4).
Severity: how findings are ranked. Nothing in this report assigns severity.
Scope of R5: whether clickable elements other than <span> and <div>, such as table rows, are covered.
Model use: whether any judgment-based check uses a model, and which one.
